items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: And Tom Johnson, who has been my recording person and sound person geez for twenty years or more than twenty years, thirty years

ctx.x: That’s with the Ohlone Wind Orchestra and that’s an adult concert band that Ohlone College sponsors and over half of them were full time professional musicians. This band is just phenomenal. And Tom Johnson, who has been my recording person and sound person geez for twenty years or more than twenty years, thirty years, was teaching there in their recording studio. They had a big recording studio and he was actually teaching recording techniques. And he arranged it. I forget how it came about. I think we were just…

Dukes of Dixieland or whatever, would sort of be surprised at. So we decided to record that. And one of the catalysts was that tune, “Vaxuosity,” which Lieutenant Commander Phil Field wrote for me, the leader of the Navy band. And that was written for concert band. And so we recorded that thing over the course of I think about six weeks. We do a few tunes at a time and then I’d be on the road a little bit and then I’d come back you know. But a lot of that stuff on that recording, that band was just sight reading.…
